name: singlet_abundance_neighborhood_da_knn_graph
title: Neighbourhood differential abundance on a kNN graph
description: Tests which neighbourhoods of a cell kNN graph change in abundance between conditions, using replicate samples as the unit, with a negative-binomial model per neighbourhood and graph-spatial FDR. The default solver is irls_lrt; use qlf to match miloR, or glmm for dependent samples with at least 60 samples. It needs an obsm embedding or obsp graph, a sample column and a design with positive residual degrees of freedom, and it writes membership, counts, results and per-cell logFC. Do not use it for cluster-level composition, per-cell scores, or when replicate samples are missing.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

design.description: Sample-level design of the neighbourhood count model.

formula.description: Design formula over obs columns, for example '~ batch + condition'; residual degrees of freedom must be positive.

sample_key.description: obs column with the biological replicate identifier; it must not be the condition column.

contrast.description: Coefficient to test; null tests the last term of the formula.

embedding.description: Embedding and graph used to define neighbourhoods.

use_rep.description: obsm key of the embedding; it must contain no missing values.

n_dims.description: Leading embedding dimensions used for the graph and index placement.

graph_key.description: Existing obsp connectivity key to reuse; null builds a kNN graph from use_rep.

k_graph.description: Neighbours per cell when building the graph; 10 matches miloR's buildGraph default.

prop.description: Fraction of cells sampled as index cells; 0.05 is suggested above about 30k cells.

k.description: Neighbourhood size used by refined index placement.

refined.description: Move each index cell to the cell nearest the median position of its neighbourhood.

min_median_cells_per_sample.description: Warning threshold for the median neighbourhood cell count per sample; not a filter.

solver.description: irls_lrt: NB GLM with likelihood-ratio test; qlf: edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test; glmm: NB GLMM.

fdr_weighting.description: k_distance: weight 1/k-distance; none: plain Benjamini-Hochberg over neighbourhoods.

alpha.description: Significance level for SpatialFDR calls and summaries.

min_mean.description: Minimum mean neighbourhood count across samples before testing.

variance_solver.description: Variance-component solver; Fisher falls back to non-negative HE on negative estimates.

max_iter.description: Maximum iterations of the mixed-model fit.

tol.description: Convergence tolerance of the mixed-model fit.

force.description: Allow fewer than 60 samples, where estimates may be unreliable.

output.description: Names and optional annotation of the written members.

key.description: Stem of the output members under obsm, uns, obs and models.

annotation_key.description: obs labels summarised per significant neighbourhood: majority label at 75 percent, otherwise Mixed.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for index-cell sampling and mixed-model starting values.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/nhood_da_nhood_logfc. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: n_neighbourhoods, n_samples, median_cells_per_sample, n_fdr_le_alpha, n_spatial_fdr_le_alpha, solver, fdr_weighting, contrast, rule_met and warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, neighbourhood count and design rank.
